method.selection: bounded directory inventory followed by targeted text and archive-name searches
method.large_tree_policy: full recursive byte counts were not required for large mounted trees; selected artifacts retain path, type, size and SHA256

top_level_inventory.name: 05-5_NPU演示
top_level_inventory.reason: Direct Milianke DR1M90GEG400 NPU package with TD project, HPF, boot candidates, DTS fragments, FSBL project, drivers and Arm NN demo archive.
top_level_inventory.task025_gap: board project identity, boot-chain source mapping, NPU software closure

top_level_inventory.name: 3-0_book_all
top_level_inventory.reason: Course PDFs; no build inputs selected for this pass.

top_level_inventory.name: 3-1_ex_fpga
top_level_inventory.reason: General FPGA/HDMI/MIPI examples; no direct NPU, Linux or board-chain dependency found in the bounded search.

top_level_inventory.name: 3-2_ex_fpsoc
top_level_inventory.reason: Generic FPSoc projects provide useful HPF, FSBL, GEG400 and boot-mode patterns; 03_boot_mode is a supporting reference, not the NPU project.

top_level_inventory.name: 3-4_ex_soc_linux
top_level_inventory.reason: General Linux/Device Tree/FSBL project contains a DR1M90GEG400 source project and boot candidates, but its kernel DTS comments out SoftNPU, its base DTS is absent, and it has no 05-5 NPU integration.
top_level_inventory.task025_gap: common Linux build-template context, not a matched NPU chain

top_level_inventory.name: D21.1_NPU_Simple_demo_sd_image
top_level_inventory.reason: Prebuilt NPU SD image retained for comparison; no evidence that it targets MLK-F3P-CZ02 rather than the AD101-family example.
top_level_inventory.task025_gap: comparison payload only; cannot substitute for MLK

top_level_inventory.name: TD_D20.1_AD101V20_2025.7
top_level_inventory.reason: Explicit AD101V20 TD/HPF example; excluded from MLK construction decisions.
top_level_inventory.task025_gap: comparison payload only; cannot substitute for MLK

skipped_or_deferred.reason: No direct NPU/Linux/BoardConfig hit in bounded search; FPGA examples are not needed to interpret the 05-5 package.
Large archives were not expanded because the selected boot-mode project already supplied the relevant GEG400/HPF/FSBL process evidence; archive identity remains outside Git.
The current directory-level scan found no large SDK/project archive in 3-4_ex_soc_linux; its extracted Sourcecode/project and Chapter 3 trees were audited directly.

Both high-value RAR v5 SDK archives were hashed and identity-recorded, but no local RAR reader is available. Their contents were not inferred from non-authoritative strings hints; 03_boot_mode was audited instead.

selected_artifact_policy: BOOT.bin, DTB, HPF, bitstream, kernel/rootfs images, modules, ELF, Arm NN libraries and models are identity-recorded only and are not copied into Git.
conclusion: 05-5_NPU演示 is the only direct NPU board-package target. Supporting Linux/FPSoc directories add process context but do not close its missing or conflicting MLK board mapping.
